Samira Ortiz: Quick reminder 90-min all-hands at 10:00am PT. Agenda: 1) exec update + ARR snapshot; 2) Q3 Dedicated capacity readiness; 3) new hosted usage quota policy overview; 4) legal notice requirements; 5) short Q&A. Please add one-line questions here or use the form: https://forms.redwood-inference/c/allhands-q

Ethan Moore: I'll present the ARR slide and the Dedicated rollout timeline.

Ravi Patel: Question: will the quota policy change affect trial/test orgs?

Samira Ortiz: Short answer: trial orgs receive a grace period (45 days) and explicit opt-in afterwards. Full details in the migration playbook.

Ivy (Legal): Flag: any enforcement steps for EU/UK customers must include 60-day notice. I'll review messaging before send.
